resolutions.researcher_notes: Status 'operating' confirmed by two independent sources. Official Petroleum Ministry 2022 results page (Mop_28122022_01.aspx) lists 'خط العامرية/العلمين/برج العرب بطول 130 كم' among lines 'تم إنجازها' (completed) during 2022. Al-Dostor (6 Apr 2023) reports GASCO 'الانتهاء من تنفيذ مشروع خط غاز العامرية-العلمين الجديدة' delivering gas to New Alamein and the coastal zone. Word 'operating' not literal but completion/commissioning context confirms it. Original dostor URL passes verifier (200); readable Wayback: https://web.archive.org/web/20230517083427/https://www.dostor.org/4357913 .

ConstructionYear 2021 supported by two independent sources. Youm7 (21 Jan 2021) lists the Amriya-Alamein line as under construction with planned completion 'يوليو 2021'. Al-Mostqbal (10 Jun 2021) quotes Minister El Molla: line 68% complete, expected start-up Q3 2021. Both place the build in 2021. Caveat: the line ultimately appears among the ministry's 2022 completions (Mop_28122022), so physical completion may have slipped into 2022 — ConstructionYear=2021 (construction commenced/planned) is defensible but the completion year could be recorded as 2022.

LengthKnown 130 km supported by the official Petroleum Ministry 2022 results page: 'مشروع خط العامرية/العلمين/برج العرب بطول 130 كم'. This exactly matches GEM's 130. CONFLICT flagged: earlier 2021 sources give 120 km for the Amriya-Alamein leg alone (Youm7 21 Jan 2021 '120 كم'; El Molla 10 Jun 2021 '120 كم'), while Al-Dostor (Apr 2023) headline says 170 km. The 130 km figure is the combined Amriya/Alamein/Borg El Arab corridor as reported officially on completion; single strong (official) source supports 130, hence medium.

Diameter 32 in confirmed by three independent sources: Youm7 (21 Jan 2021) 'قطر 32"', Al-Dostor (Apr 2023) 'قطر ٣٢ بوصة', El Molla via Al-Mostqbal (Jun 2021) 'قطر 32"'. No conflict; consistent across construction and completion reporting.

FuelSource value is the petroleum.gov.eg national-gas-network PDF URL itself. Verified live (HTTP 200) and, via pdftotext, the document explicitly describes 'خط غاز العامرية/العلمين لتوصيل الغاز الطبيعى لمناطق الساحل الشمالى حتى مدينة العلمين الجديدة' — i.e. the line carries natural gas (الغاز الطبيعى) as part of the national gas network. Official source; fuel = natural gas corroborated by Youm7 and Al-Dostor which all describe a natural-gas line.

Endpoints Amriya (العامرية, in Alexandria governorate) → El Alamein (العلمين الجديدة, in Matruh governorate) confirmed by two independent sources: official ministry page ('خط العامرية/العلمين/برج العرب') and Al-Dostor ('خط غاز العامرية-العلمين الجديدة لتوصيل الغاز... للمنطقة الساحلية'). El Molla via Al-Mostqbal also states it feeds New Alamein city and the North Coast. Consistent with GEM start=Amriya/Alexandria, end=El Alamein/Matruh.

SegmentCost 2,000,000,000 EGP supported by Youm7 (21 Jan 2021): 'خط العامرية برج العرب/العلمين بطول 120 كم - قطر 32" تكلفة المشروع 2مليار جنيه'. CONFLICT flagged: Minister El Molla via Al-Mostqbal (10 Jun 2021) states 'بتكلفة استثمارية 540 مليون جنيه' (540 million EGP) for the same 120 km / 32" Amriya-Alamein line. GEM's 2 billion matches the Youm7 figure; the two Egyptian sources disagree by ~4x. Single source supports the stated value, hence medium; recommend human review of the 540M vs 2B discrepancy.

Owner1 = Egyptian Natural Gas Holding Co (EGAS) supported inferentially: the official petroleum.gov.eg national-gas-network document places the Amriya/Alamein line inside 'الشبكة القومية للغازات الطبيعية' (the national gas network, an EGAS/ministry asset), and Youm7 lists it under national-network projects. CAVEAT to flag: every media source names the executor/operator as GASCO (الشركة المصرية للغازات الطبيعية) — a transmission subsidiary within the EGAS holding group — not EGAS directly. So GEM's holding-level owner=EGAS is defensible, but GASCO is the named builder/operator; recommend confirming whether owner should be EGAS or GASCO.
